question: What claim about the agency behind this yoginī is at stake in saying she is named by will, known by the siddhas, and extends to the end of māyā by supreme will?
premises: The yoginī is named by will.
She is known by the siddhas.
She extends to the end of māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named by will is presented as extending to the end of māyā through supreme will and as known by the siddhas.
uncertainties: The precise function of this yoginī is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: The yoginī named by will, by the siddhas, to the end of māyā, by supreme will.
